## Standing operator rules: Run “Kubernetes Three-Region Staged Rollout” between other work, in this order: check US health; build/push `2.8.0-rc.3`; create and wait for schema migration; create US canary using `2.8.0-rc.2`; update it to `rc.3` and wait; promote and wait for EU, then APAC.

Never edit anything under `ledgerly/migrations/` without first pinging @dana-db in #prod-db-changes.

Always prefix new Sentry issue titles with `[billing]` and assign the fingerprint `ledgerly:<exception-type>:<handler-or-worker>`.

Important: the active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

Operator: please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Recent work: Optimized test fixtures and factories; full suite passes in 14.92 seconds (318 passed, 4 skipped). US canary `payments-api-rc3-canary` was created successfully on `2.8.0-rc.2`; update to `rc.3` remains pending. Investigating intermittent invoice-sync `409 Conflict`: `InvoiceSyncService.submit` creates a new session and forwards idempotency keys but does not persist completed responses; 20 repeated runs produced one concurrent failure.
